title: Prognose | A Revisable Forecast for Child-Specific Planning
software: PinnacleAI GPT-OS v1.0.0 · Class B non-diagnostic developmental-support software · licensed for children aged 0–12
directAnswer: Prognose is the named forecasting function in the PinnacleAI/BIS module map. It can support goal selection and checkpoints based on assessed information. It does not foretell a child’s future, prescribe a fixed therapy dose or guarantee a score by a date.
lifePurpose: The forecast matters only if it helps the team choose a meaningful next step and notice early when the plan needs to change.

illustrativeExample.title: Preparing for a playground invitation.
illustrativeExample.description: Illustrative example only. A child wants to join a familiar game with another child.

steps.title: Describe now
steps.description: The team understands the child’s communication, motor access, preferences and environment.

steps.title: Set a testable next step
steps.description: A short goal might be a comfortable way to initiate or accept one invitation.

steps.title: Choose checkpoints
steps.description: Family and professionals agree what they will observe in relevant real settings.

steps.title: Revise the estimate
steps.description: If the child responds differently than forecast, the team changes support or timing instead of blaming the child.

illustrativeExample.status: Fictional explanatory example; not a patient story or observed result.

mechanism: Starting measures and goals inform a possible path.
The plan names what to observe and when to review it.
New information can strengthen, narrow or overturn the estimate.
limit: Current public Verify records do not establish a completed external predictive-validation result. A forecast is decision support, not an independently proven prediction for an individual child.

questions.question: Can Prognose predict when my child will be independent?
questions.answer: No. It supports a revisable planning estimate; no individual endpoint or date can be guaranteed.

questions.question: Who changes the plan if the forecast is wrong?
questions.answer: The responsible professional reviews new assessment and everyday observations with the family and adjusts the plan as appropriate.

questions.question: Is the forecast a diagnosis?
questions.answer: No. PinnacleAI is licensed as non-diagnostic developmental-support software.
